transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?
I feel like my feelings and motivation have dried up; it’s getting harder to connect with my clients or even with my own life. I just feel completely shut down inside, and I can't seem to shake it.
How long have you been feeling this way—has it been most days for at least two years, or did it start after a specific stressful event and improve at any point?

It hasn't been two years, but rather started building about eight months ago when my aunt's medical issues got worse and my caseload at work really picked up. It hasn't improved at all; it's just been a gradual, continuous decline where I feel more and more shut down.

During this time, have you also had a depressed mood or loss of interest most of the day nearly every day, along with changes in sleep, appetite, energy, concentration, or feelings of worthlessness or guilt?

I haven't really noticed major changes in my sleep or appetite, and I don't feel a typical sadness or feelings of guilt. Instead, it feels more like being completely blank, heavy, and shut down inside, where my motivation and emotions have just dried up.
In the past eight months, have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy, or felt down/depressed most of the day nearly every day?

Yes, I've stopped doing almost everything I used to enjoy, like my yoga classes, art outings, and seeing my friends. But it doesn't feel like a typical active sadness or depression; it's more of a heavy, blank, "shut-down" feeling. It's like someone turned the volume completely down on my emotions and my drive.

Did these symptoms start within a few months of the stressors you mentioned, and have they mainly affected your ability to function at work or in relationships? Also, do you feel the symptoms are clearly tied to those stressors, or do they seem to be happening on their own?

Yes, they started about eight months ago alongside my aunt's illness and my heavy caseload, and it has severely impacted me—I've been written up at work, had clients reassigned, and I'm completely isolating at home. While I initially thought it was just caregiving stress, this shut-down feeling now feels much deeper and like it's happening entirely on its own. It goes way beyond any typical stress or burnout I've ever experienced.
Have you had any thoughts that life is not worth living, or thoughts of hurting yourself or ending your life?
No, I haven't had any thoughts of hurting myself or ending my life. Even though I feel completely empty and shut down inside, those kinds of thoughts haven't crossed my mind.
Did your symptoms begin within a few months of the stressor and seem mainly tied to it, or have they continued to worsen even when the stressor eased?

Yes, they started about eight months ago right as my aunt's health declined and my work caseload became overwhelming, and those stressors haven't really let up. Instead, things have actually continued to worsen and even change; for instance, the feeling that people at work and the hospital are secretly evaluating me and sending hidden messages only started about two months ago.
When you notice people at work or the hospital sending hidden messages, do you believe that is definitely true, or do you recognize it might be your mind playing tricks on you?

I know my supervisor insists it's just routine feedback and paperwork, but it feels incredibly real to me. Even when I try to rationalize it, I find it really hard to shake the belief that there is indeed a coordinated effort to secretly evaluate me at work and the hospital.
Have you ever heard voices, seen things others could not, or had other experiences like these hidden messages that feel clearly real to you?

I have never heard voices or seen things that aren't there, but the hidden messages feel completely real to me. For about two months now, I've been convinced there's a coordinated effort at work and at my aunt's hospital, where people drop hints in emails and meetings about evaluating me for a secret program. My supervisor tells me it's just routine feedback, but I just can't shake the feeling that it's actually happening.

Before this started, had you ever had a similar episode of low mood, loss of interest, or feeling shut down for at least two weeks when there was no major stressor, or is this the first time it has happened?
No, I've never experienced anything like this before. This is the very first time I have felt so shut down and lost interest in my life, and I have no prior history of similar episodes.

Over the past two weeks, have you been feeling depressed or down most of the day nearly every day, and have you had changes in sleep, appetite, energy, concentration, or feelings of worthlessness or excessive guilt?

I haven't really felt depressed or guilty over the last two weeks, and I haven't noticed any specific changes in my sleep or appetite. It still feels much more like a heavy, blank lack of motivation and emotion rather than sadness. I just feel completely empty and shut down inside.
Have you ever felt that your thoughts were being broadcast, controlled, or inserted by someone else, or that your experiences were definitely not real?

No, I have never felt like my thoughts were being broadcast, controlled, or inserted by someone else. I also don't feel like my experiences aren't real; everything I'm going through feels very real and heavy to me.

Have the suspicious beliefs about hidden messages and being evaluated been present only during times when you felt shut down or depressed, or did they ever happen when your mood felt otherwise normal?

No, those thoughts only started about two months ago, which was well after I already began feeling shut down and emotionally blank eight months ago. I have never experienced these suspicious thoughts during any period when I felt normal.
Have your symptoms mostly been a reaction to the stressful situation and improved when stress eased, or have they persisted and kept worsening even when the stressors were not as intense?

They definitely haven't improved; the shut-down feeling has been steadily building and worsening over the past eight months. Even though it started around the time my aunt got sick and my caseload grew, it has persisted continuously, and in the last two months, it's actually gotten worse with these new, unsettling feelings of being secretly evaluated and receiving hidden messages.
Have you ever had any unusual beliefs or experiences like the hidden messages or feeling evaluated before this episode started, or do these only happen during this current illness?

No, I have never experienced anything like this before this current illness. These feelings of being evaluated and seeing hidden messages are completely new and only started about two months ago, well after I already felt shut down. Before this, I never had any unusual beliefs or experiences like these.
Have you ever heard voices, seen things others could not, or believed things that other people clearly said were not true?

No, I have never heard voices or seen things that aren't there. However, for the last couple of months, I have believed there is a coordinated effort at work and at my aunt's hospital to secretly investigate or evaluate me, even though my supervisor insists it's just routine feedback.
Have the suspicious beliefs about being secretly evaluated ever continued for at least 2 weeks when you were not feeling shut down or depressed, or do they only happen during this current episode?

No, they only happen during this current episode and have never occurred when I felt normal. These suspicious thoughts only started about two months ago, whereas the shut-down feeling has been building for eight months. I've never had these beliefs at any other time in my life.
Have the suspicious beliefs about being secretly evaluated ever lasted for at least 2 weeks when you were not feeling shut down or depressed, or do they only happen during this current episode?

No, they have never happened when I was feeling like my normal self. These suspicious thoughts only started about two months ago, which is well after I already began feeling shut down and blank eight months ago. They are strictly occurring during this current difficult period.

Besides the suspicious beliefs, have you had any other unusual experiences such as hearing voices, seeing things others don’t see, or feeling that your thoughts are being controlled or inserted by someone else?
No, I haven't experienced any of those things. I have never heard any voices, seen things that aren't there, or felt like my thoughts were being controlled or inserted by someone else.
Have you ever heard voices, seen things other people could not, or felt that your thoughts were being controlled, inserted, or broadcast to others?
No, I have never heard any voices or seen things that aren't there. I also haven't ever felt like my thoughts were being controlled, inserted, or broadcast to anyone else.
Have the suspicious beliefs ever continued for at least 2 weeks when you were not feeling shut down or depressed, or do they only happen during this current episode?

No, they have never happened outside of this current episode. These suspicious thoughts only started about two months ago, while the shut-down feeling has been going on for eight months. I have never experienced these beliefs or felt evaluated like this before this period began.

When the suspicious beliefs started two months ago, were you also having a clearly depressed mood or loss of interest most of the day nearly every day, or did the beliefs appear even when your mood felt otherwise normal?

Yes, that heavy, blank feeling and lack of motivation had already been going on for about eight months when those suspicious thoughts started. It wasn't a typical "sad" depression, but rather a numb, emotionally flat state, and that blankness was very much present when I began feeling like I was being secretly evaluated.
Have you ever had a period of at least 2 weeks when you were feeling completely normal, but the suspicious beliefs or hidden messages were still present?

No, I haven't felt normal at all since those thoughts started. The heavy, shut-down feeling and lack of motivation began eight months ago, whereas the thoughts about secret evaluations only started two months ago. Because of that, these suspicious thoughts have only existed while I was already feeling very unwell and disengaged.
Have you ever had a period of at least 2 weeks when your mood and motivation felt normal, but you still believed people were secretly evaluating you or sending hidden messages?

No, I haven't experienced that. The lack of motivation and emotional flatness started first, about eight months ago, whereas the feeling of being secretly evaluated only began two months ago. Therefore, I have never had a period where my motivation was normal while having those thoughts.
Have you ever had at least 2 weeks when your mood and motivation felt back to normal, but you still believed people were secretly evaluating you or sending hidden messages?

No, I haven't had any period where my mood and motivation returned to normal. This heavy, shut-down feeling has been completely constant for the past eight months. The thoughts about being secretly evaluated only started about two months ago, while I was already feeling this way.
Have you ever had a period of at least 2 weeks when your mood and motivation felt back to normal, but you still believed people were secretly evaluating you or sending hidden messages?

No, I haven't had a period like that. The heavy, unmotivated feeling started about eight months ago and has been constant, while the thoughts about being secretly evaluated only began about two months ago. Since these issues overlap, I haven't felt normal or motivated at any point since those thoughts started.
Have you ever had at least 2 weeks when your mood and motivation felt back to normal, but you still believed people were secretly evaluating you or sending hidden messages?

No, I haven't experienced a period like that. My mood and motivation have felt consistently low and heavy ever since this all started, and they haven't gone back to normal at all. Because of that, I've never had a time where I felt fine but still believed I was being evaluated.
Have you ever heard voices, seen things others could not, or felt that your thoughts were being controlled, inserted, or broadcast to others?
No, I have never heard any voices or seen things that aren't there. I also haven't ever felt like my thoughts were being controlled, inserted, or broadcast to anyone else.
Have the suspicious beliefs ever happened for at least 2 weeks when you were not feeling shut down, blank, or depressed, or do they only occur during this current episode?

No, they have never happened when I was feeling normal. These suspicious thoughts only started about two months ago, which is well after I already began feeling shut down and blank eight months ago. I've only ever experienced them during this current episode.
Have you ever had at least 2 weeks when you felt emotionally normal, but still believed people were secretly evaluating you or sending hidden messages?

No, I haven't had a period like that. The feeling of being emotionally flat and shut down started about eight months ago, while the thoughts about being secretly evaluated only began much more recently, about two months ago. Therefore, I was already feeling completely empty when those beliefs started.

final_diagnosis.reason: The presentation is most consistent with a depressive episode with psychotic features: an eight-month continuous depressive syndrome marked by marked anhedonia, emotional numbness, loss of motivation, social withdrawal, and clear functional impairment, with new-onset persecutory/ideas-of-reference-type delusional beliefs emerging only during the depressive episode. There is no evidence of schizophrenia-spectrum psychotic symptoms independent of mood, no hallucinations, and no manic symptoms. The duration and symptom pattern argue against brief psychotic disorder and favor a depressive episode with psychotic symptoms.
